name: ScenePilot-Bench
description: ScenePilot-Bench is a large-scale first-person autonomous driving benchmark for vision-language models. It evaluates scene understanding, spatial perception, motion planning, and safety-aware reasoning from driving videos with structured annotations and cross-region generalization settings.
evaluation_method: Mixed evaluation using task-specific accuracy, planning/trajectory metrics, safety-aware scores, and GPT-Score-style rubric evaluation
notes: Built on ScenePilot-4K with 3,847 hours of driving videos and rich annotations. The benchmark emphasizes first-person perception and planning for VLMs, including cross-region generalization and safety-sensitive assessment.
